page_note: Page 183 contains NO cosmological substrate. The first unit (segs 0-8) ends a discussion of fasts, prayers, and good works — pastoral/ecclesial. The second and third units begin Kephalaion 76, "The Summoning" — a hagiographic-biographical narrative about Mani being summoned by Sapor (Shapur) the king at Ctesiphon, followed by an apostolic dialogue with the disciple Aurades requesting two anointed-ones like Mani. This is Manichaean institutional hagiography wrapped in apostolic dialogue frame. Heavy damage (90.9%) but the surviving text is unambiguously editorial. Teaching purity 0.000 confirms no substrate.
